subject: Response stall investigation and ops briefing (Kunda Technologies)
messages:
From: support@kundatech.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: ops@kundatech.com
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Streaming responses stall on long generations - urgent

Hi Jasmine,

We're seeing repeated stalls on streaming outputs from the Redwood API across multiple jobs this morning. For several requests that should be ~1.5k tokens we start receiving tokens for ~3–6 seconds and then the stream stops emitting altogether; the connection stays open but no further tokens arrive. Non-streaming completions return a final empty chunk with status 200. This started ~08:45 PT and is affecting 3 teams here.

Example: request-id abc123 (attached trace). We tried increasing client timeouts and switching from streaming to polling — same behavior. Can you confirm if there's a known outage or active incident? This is impacting our customer demos scheduled this afternoon.

Thanks,
Aaron Mills
Support Lead, Kunda Technologies

Attachments: request-trace-abc123.json (trace), kundatech_error_log_excerpt.txt (server-side excerpts)
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: support@kundatech.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-28T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Streaming responses stall on long generations - urgent

Hi Aaron — thanks for the report and the trace. We're opening an incident on this now and prioritizing it. Short summary of immediate actions: 

- We've routed your traffic to a fallback generation variant (non-quantized medium model) to unblock ongoing demos. You should see stable behavior within ~5 minutes.
- We're collecting server-side traces and a set of request ids (including abc123) and will share findings.
- On our side the incident is tracked as IR-2026-06-28-1 and we've posted an initial notice on the status page: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/IR-2026-06-28-1

Temporary ask for you: when you have a minute please confirm whether the fallback resolves the stream stalls for the affected jobs. If it does not, send the next failing request id and approximate wall-clock time.

I'll keep you updated as the engineering team investigates root cause. Apologies for the disruption — we know demos are time-sensitive.

— Jasmine Liu
Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, support@kundatech.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-28T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: IR-2026-06-28-1 — initial findings and mitigations

Hi all,

Quick update from the runtime team after initial trace analysis. We reproduced the stall pattern in-house for requests with long sequences and a specific tokenization fingerprint (heavy punctuation runs — many em-dashes and long repeated Unicode sequences).

Preliminary root cause (summary):
- A race in the KV-cache eviction path for the quantized inference variant can lead to a stalled decoder loop when a particular tokenization pattern collapses the attention window index.
- The stalled decoder doesn't produce tokens but keeps the session alive, which is why streaming clients see an open connection with no progress.

Immediate mitigations applied:
- We routed affected customers (including Kunda) off the quantized model variant to the non-quantized 'redwood-medium' pool — this is the fallback Jasmine pushed earlier.
- A routing rule was pushed at 12:15 PT to prevent the quantized path for new sessions from high-risk tokenization fingerprints while we ship a fix.
- We collected a set of traces (attached: request-trace-abc123.json) and a log excerpt sample for the incident.

Next steps:
- Patch for the eviction race under review; expected rollout to staging by EOD and production by tomorrow morning (2026-06-29).
- Longer-term: add tokenization fingerprint checks and a fast-fail route to fallback variant to avoid customer impact during rollout windows.

Aaron — can you confirm if the routed fallback restored normal generation for the sessions you tested earlier? Any additional failing request ids would help us correlate.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Staff SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: request-trace-abc123.json (server trace excerpt)
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: support@kundatech.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-28T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: IR-2026-06-28-1 — resolved (postmortem forthcoming)

Hi Aaron — quick final update for the day: 

- Impact: Some streaming generation sessions experienced a long-tail stall condition between ~08:45–12:30 PT that could leave an open connection without new tokens. We believe ~4% of long-running generation sessions across a small subset of tokenization fingerprints were affected.
- Resolution: At 12:15 PT we applied routing mitigations to avoid the quantized variant for high-risk fingerprints and pushed a hotfix to the routing layer. Customer traffic (including your workspaces) was smoothly moved to the fallback pool; we saw normal token emission resumes within minutes.
- Customer impact: Kunda reported mitigation working for the demonstration traffic — thank you for confirming.

What we'll deliver next week: 
- Full postmortem (public summary for customers and internal engineering timeline) by 2026-07-05.
- Mitigation runbook (attached) with guidance for operators and an RCA write-up.
- A permanent fix to the eviction race targeted for rollout by 2026-06-29, plus improved detection for the fingerprint that triggered this.

Attachments: mitigation-runbook.pdf (internal), kundatech_error_log_excerpt.txt, request-trace-abc123.json.

If you prefer a short call to walk through the timeline and what changed in routing, I'm available tomorrow 10–11 PT. Thanks again for your patience — very sorry about the disruption.

— Jasmine Liu
Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
